# 00000006566

**OS3-16 ★** — source: 204_算子分裂法_数值PDEII.md

**English.** Definition: The Lie closure with the Lie-algebra closure generated by splitting. Conjecture: The dimension controls the preservable quantities and the control bound is the codimension difference; the spectrum of codimension differences is finite for compact Lie algebras; and the preserved-quantity count is the logarithm of the closure dimension. (dimension-control bound of Lie closures)

**中文。** 定义：李闭包：分裂生成的李代数闭包。猜想：维数控制可保持量且控制的界为余维差；余维差的谱在紧李代数有限；保持量的个数为闭包维数的对数。（李闭包维数控制界结构）
